description: `|` union, `&` intersection, `-` difference, `^` symmetric difference, `<=` subset. Both sides must be sets.
`union`, `intersection`, `difference`... accept any iterable, not only sets.
An immutable, hashable set. Usable as a dict key or set member.
Builds a dict from keys. `list(dict.fromkeys(items))` removes duplicates and keeps first-seen order.
`set()`. The literal `{}` is an empty dict.
